priorAbsorption: MAO-OA-T2 adds one bounded local file-backed durable run store persisting an immutable task graph plus append-only event entries under a caller-supplied root directory, with deterministic replay through the existing MaoEventLedger and fail-closed recovery. AKOE-P2-R2 additionally records the exact Vite runner path and the literal EXTENSIONS/** audit-scope token disclosed by its frozen worker return so the corpus registry gate can evaluate the staged evidence without widening any implementation claim. It does not establish worker/provider launch, lifecycle, reviewer/closer, public, or production authority.
nextScanRecommendation: Re-scan when a later authorized MAO operational-adoption tranche changes this durable run-store surface.
